name: Sattu Chilla
steps: Whisk sattu, gram flour, turmeric and salt with the water until smooth. Rest for 10 minutes so the flour hydrates.
Finely chop onion, tomato, chilli and coriander. Stir them into the batter with cumin; the batter should pour in a thick ribbon.
Heat a nonstick griddle over medium heat and grease lightly, using the measured oil across all batches. Pour a portion of batter and spread gently into a 15 cm pancake.
Cook for 3 minutes until the top sets and the underside browns. Drizzle a little oil around the edge, flip carefully and cook for 2 minutes until fully cooked.
Repeat to make 8 chillas, stirring the batter before each portion. Serve warm while the edges are crisp.
tips: Use roasted chana sattu rather than raw chickpea flour; the added gram flour helps bind these delicate pancakes.
notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.
